nodes.label: Job Boards Skill: JobsDB / SEEK Family
data-automation Attribute Selectors
nodes.rationale: JobsDB/JobStreet/SEEK are one platform behind six domains sharing a URL grammar and DOM contract; data-automation attributes are stable and semantic, so they are preferred over CSS classes and the contract learned once transfers across all domains.

nodes.label: Direct Search URL Construction (JobsDB)
nodes.rationale: Typing into the site's search box is what trips detection, so URLs are constructed and navigated directly; default relevance sort plus daterange=7 surfaces better matches than sortmode=ListedDate, which degrades page 1 to whatever posted in the last hour.

nodes.label: Camoufox Stealth Requirement
nodes.source_location: Stealth is required, and it is sufficient
nodes.rationale: curl gets 403 on hk.jobsdb.com regardless of UA while Camoufox gets 200 first try with no CAPTCHA, so http_get attempts are a wasted turn and a dry curl scan must never be read as an empty market.

nodes.label: LinkedIn Guest Jobs API
nodes.source_location: Mainland China: the LinkedIn guest API
nodes.rationale: The jobs-guest endpoint returns cards with exact ISO dates and no auth, but ~20 calls in it starts returning 429s that render as empty result sets rather than errors, so a sudden zero after heavy paging must be treated as throttling (unknown), not as a genuine finding; space calls ~15s apart.
